body.title: Add discoverCodexMcpServers and replace codexReadOnlySessionArgs
body.summary: Implement discoverCodexMcpServers(binPath, cwd, timeoutMs, signal) with the corrected '-C cwd mcp list --json' argv; replace the current 3-argument, unrestricted codexReadOnlySessionArgs with the new 4-argument, pure/synchronous builder that takes the discovered servers list, throws CodexMcpServerNotRegisteredError when insrc is absent, and otherwise emits the existing base argv plus the insrc enabled_tools override and one disable override per other server.
acceptanceChecks: discoverCodexMcpServers' subprocess argv places '-C', cwd before 'mcp', 'list', '--json'
discoverCodexMcpServers propagates a plain Error on non-zero exit, timeout, abort, or unparseable JSON
codexReadOnlySessionArgs, given insrc plus other servers, returns the existing base argv plus the enabled_tools override and one disable override per other server, excluding insrc's own name
codexReadOnlySessionArgs throws CodexMcpServerNotRegisteredError synchronously, with no argv constructed, when insrc is absent from the servers list

tests.name: discoverCodexMcpServers' subprocess invocation places '-C', cwd BEFORE 'mcp', 'list', '--json'
codexReadOnlySessionArgs, given insrc plus two other servers, returns the enabled_tools override and one disable override per other server
codexReadOnlySessionArgs throws CodexMcpServerNotRegisteredError synchronously, with no argv constructed, when insrc is absent from the servers list
codex: the previously-covered misregistration, budget/cancellation, and functional-proof tests, unaffected by this round's exact-path-exclusion fix
